question: What is the principle of supreme Bhairava worship taught in the Ḍāmara?
premises: That which draws in all attributes is established there as supreme.
All others stand in a lower position.
This is the principle of supreme Bhairava worship in the great rite of the revered Ḍāmara.
inference: Supreme worship centers on the unifying principle that comprehends all attributes, as taught in the Ḍāmara's great rite.
plain_english: That which draws in all attributes is established there as supreme, while all others stand lower; such is the principle of supreme Bhairava worship in the great rite of the revered Ḍāmara.
